scenario_name: Unsealed Polybag — Electronics with USB Cable

polybag_present.reason: Transparent outer polybag is clearly present enclosing the electronic device and USB cable.

polybag_sealed.reason: CRITICAL: Polybag top opening is visibly open and unsecured — plastic edges are splayed apart with no heat-seal, tape, or closure of any kind.

fnsku_placement.reason: FNSKU label X0034H1QAJ is affixed flat on the lower front surface of the polybag, not crossing any seam or edge.

fnsku_surface.reason: Surface classification: flat. Label is smooth and not placed on an opening, seam, or curved edge.

suffocation_warning.reason: No suffocation warning text visible anywhere on the polybag surface — front, back, or bottom.

suffocation_legibility.reason: Not applicable — suffocation warning is entirely absent.

manufacturer_barcode.reason: Inner product is wrapped in an opaque black bag within the outer polybag. Original manufacturer barcode on the inner device is not visible from this angle — cannot confirm coverage.

annotations.label: ⚠ OPEN SEAL — FAIL
annotations.note: Top opening is completely unsecured — plastic edges visibly splayed. No heat-seal or tape.

annotations.label: FNSKU Label — X0034H1QAJ
annotations.note: Flat placement on front surface — PASS. Note: no FNSKU title header visible on this label.

annotations.label: ⚠ WARNING ABSENT — FAIL
annotations.note: No suffocation warning printed anywhere on this bag.

annotations.label: Inner Black Bag
annotations.note: Inner product is wrapped in an opaque black bag — original barcode occlusion UNCERTAIN.

quality_flags.notes: Front-facing image only. Crinkled/wrinkled polybag in the mid-section is a valuable real-world training example. Open top seal is clearly visible and unambiguous.

prd_rules_triggered: PRD §3.1 — Polybag must be sealed prior to inbound. An open bag is an immediate FAIL.
PRD §4.2 — All polybags must carry a printed suffocation warning.
training_notes.vrd_model_learning_value: HIGH — This image teaches the model two distinct failure modes in one shot: (1) recognise open top seam geometry as unsealed, (2) confirm absent warning. Also introduces the UNCERTAIN pattern for barcodes hidden by inner secondary packaging.
